register_type: Manual evidence intake. This is a MANUAL SUBSTITUTE for the private Atlas Librarian (atlas_gov.hunter_librarian.classify_source_admissibility), which is not available to this public agent and was NOT run. Classifications below are the Analyst's own, made by hand under O-LIBRARIAN-SOURCE-ADMISSIBILITY, and are subject to Challenger and Magistrate review. They are claim-relative: a class applies to the named claim type only. Librarian-style classification determines admissibility only, not truth.
hash_method: sha256 over file bytes, computed with sha256sum and again inside analysis.py (K-00); all nine match 00_matter/PREREGISTRATION.md. A hash establishes file integrity, not factual accuracy (O-SOURCE-GROUNDED-INDEPENDENT-VERIFICATION §1; Constitution Art. XIV §2).

classifications.claim_type: Published weighted pct_online_primary and unweighted n for FINAL months 2024-01..2026-07
classifications.reason: Data owner's own published series (the witness for what the tracker reported); identifiable source; integrity preserved (hash matches pre-registration); point-in-time valid; internally consistent with tracker_by_age.csv (K-15: age cells recombine to topline within 0.06 pts, n sums match 32/32 months).

classifications.claim_type: August 2026 value (36.3, n=411) as the August level
classifications.reason: Marked PRELIMINARY; methodology_notes 2026-08 says partial sample to be replaced at final close (expected 2026-10-06). Trusted only as 'the preliminary partial-sample figure reported', not as the August measurement.

classifications.claim_type: Comparability of months before vs after 2026-03
classifications.reason: The file itself carries no mode flag; methodology_notes 2026-03 states the series is not adjusted for the fieldwork transition. The raw series cannot by itself support like-for-like change claims across Feb->Mar 2026.

classifications.claim_type: Published age-group values and n for FINAL months
classifications.reason: Same owner and provenance as topline; consistent with topline (K-15). Note small cells (18-24 n~300, SRS SE ~2.8 pts, K-16): admissible, but individual month changes are imprecise.

classifications.claim_type: Consumer segments other than age (income, region, household type, etc.)
classifications.reason: File contains age only. No admissible source for other segments exists in the authorized data.

classifications.claim_type: Size of the fieldwork-mode difference (online panel minus legacy mixed mode) in February 2026, all adults
classifications.reason: Data owner's own parallel methodology study designed for exactly this proposition (the witness for mode effect); referenced in methodology_notes 2026-03; ALL rows reconcile to age cells (K-05). Admissible as a single-wave sampling estimate (SE ~1.3 pts, K-05); precision is an analytic limit, not an admissibility defect.
Same provenance; admissible as measured, but per-cell SEs 2.0..4.1 pts (K-06) mean the cells cannot distinguish age-specific effects from a common effect (heterogeneity p=0.57).

classifications.claim_type: Mode difference at dates other than February 2026
classifications.reason: Point-in-time validity: the study was fielded once. Stability of the mode effect after February is an assumption, not measured.

classifications.claim_type: Whether bridge figures are weighted with the tracker scheme
classifications.reason: File does not state it. methodology_notes does not state it.
